compiled_state.title: tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-*.sh use source-grepping rather than execution-based assertions
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Component
tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-*.sh (9 files)

## Condition
Multiple test files use grep/awk against \$MERGE_SCRIPT source contents to validate implementation patterns (e.g., 'awk /^_phase_sync/ \"$MERGE_SCRIPT\"', 'grep -qE \"git reset HEAD\" \"$MERGE_SCRIPT\"').

## Observed Result
Per the d5cb-c871 dispatcher split, the implementation moved from merge-to-main.sh to merge-to-main-direct.sh. The 9 affected test files were re-pinned (single-line MERGE_SCRIPT redirection) to keep greps finding their targets.

## Why this is a bug
Behavioral testing standard Rule 3 (Execute, don't inspect) prohibits source-file-grepping change-detector tests. The re-pin extends the change-detector treadmill — when the implementation refactors again, these tests will need re-pinning again. Surfaced by code-reviewer-test-quality during d5cb-c871 review.

## Affected files
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh (~21 grep/awk patterns)
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-ucq2.sh (~10)
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-config-driven.sh (~8)
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-cleanliness.sh
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-ci-workflow-name.sh
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-resume-cwd.sh
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-resume-push-idempotent.sh
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-stale-version-bump-reset.sh

## Remediation
For each grep/awk-against-MERGE_SCRIPT site: either DELETE (if behavior is covered by an execution-based test elsewhere) or REPLACE with execution-based assertions that exercise the script and assert observable outputs (exit code, stdout, side-effect on filesystem/git).

## Triage notes
Out of scope for d5cb-c871 (structural refactor); deferred via this ticket. Severity: low — tests pass and protect against regression, but architecture violates testing standard.

comments.body: Investigation: 22 source-grepping instances across 9 test files. Most check architectural contracts (SIGURG handler, version bump phase, retry logic) that require execution mocks with fake git environments to convert properly. Converting all instances would be a dedicated multi-story effort, not a single bug fix. Partial conversion risks leaving inconsistent test coverage. Recommend creating a story in the testing-quality epic to tackle this systematically. Not fixable in a debug session without significant regression risk.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: INVESTIGATION: Confirmed 9 test files with ~39 grep/awk-against-MERGE_SCRIPT patterns. Per the ticket, remediation requires either deleting redundant tests or rewriting each grep assertion as an execution-based test that invokes the script and asserts observable outputs. This is a multi-session effort — each rewrite needs RED/GREEN cycle for each behavioral assertion. Recommend prioritizing the ~21 patterns in test-merge-to-main.sh first (highest concentration). Leave open as follow-up for a dedicated session.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Investigated: scope is too large for autonomous resolution. ~50+ grep/awk source-inspection sites across 9 test files. Each remediation requires reading the assertion's intent, finding (or writing) an execution-based equivalent, and proving the new test catches the same regression class. This is multi-day work for one engineer. Recommend filing as an epic and decomposing per-test-file via /dso:preplanning rather than a single-fix track. Skipping for now.

comments.body: Fixed source-grepping assertions in 6 test files. Approach: (1) test-merge-to-main-config-driven.sh — replaced 8 grep-on-MERGE_SCRIPT assertions with 6 behavioral tests using WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE injection + mock binaries to verify _phase_validate actually uses config-specified commands at runtime; (2) test-merge-to-main-ci-workflow-name.sh — replaced 4 grep-on-MERGE_SCRIPT assertions with 3 behavioral tests that source the script in library mode and verify CI_WORKFLOW_NAME resolution + DEPRECATION warning emission; (3) test-merge-to-main-ucq2.sh — deleted 11 structural source-grepping tests (Tests 1-11) covered by existing integration tests 13-17, added 2 behavioral replacements for the ancestor-guard (Test 8) and merge-not-rebase (Test 9) behaviors; (4) test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh — deleted 1 structural HAS_PHASE_FN grep (covered by the 9 integration tests that call _phase_version_bump directly); (5) test-merge-to-main-cleanliness.sh — replaced Test 7 source-ordering check with behavioral test that verifies git reset HEAD clears staged files; (6) test-merge-to-main-resume-cwd.sh — replaced 5 source-grepping assertions (Tests 1-5) with 4 behavioral tests that invoke each phase from wrong CWD and assert correct results. Remaining awk/sed patterns in test files are all in _extract_fn helpers used to eval+call functions for behavioral testing (not source inspection assertions). All 297 tests pass.
